description: Source code for the GameScreen widget of a Flutter-based chess frontend. Contains UI components for rendering the game board, move history, and handling user interaction in a chess game, including initial setup and move handling.

classes.name: GameScreenArgs
classes.description: Holds arguments for initializing the game screen, primarily the game mode (local, ai, online).

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the chess game screen, manages game state and UI layout.

methods.name: _initialBoard
methods.description: Sets up the initial chessboard with standard starting positions.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on squares; manages piece selection and move execution.

methods.name: _openMoves
methods.description: Displays the move history in a modal bottom sheet.

methods.name: _showStub
methods.description: Displays a stub dialog for features not implemented yet.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method constructing the entire UI layout for the game screen.
